integration.cgi_before_overlay: Preserve the modern LuCI CGI as www/cgi-bin/luci.ucode before copying the wrapper.
integration.uhttpd: Keep HTTP 80 and add 0.0.0.0:82 for the existing APP protocol.
integration.init: Use the theme myos-nros-app init containing the myos-usage instance.
integration.broker: Disable the stock mosquitto init/rc links; myos-nros-mqtt owns its broker.
integration.cache: Install the latest overlay/usr/libexec/myos-nbcpe-status with interfaces/sim_slot fields.
integration.identity: No identity files or credentials are included. Existing same-device identity and the original user binding/settings flow remain available.
integration.default_cloud: Disabled unless first boot finds an already valid same-device identity and device code.
integration.modem: AK68 cache owns signal reads; no additional AT polling. Neighbour data are unknown. Native AK68 modem UI remains available.
